source_time_text: Sep 17, 2026 12:00pm BST (BoE release; FF observed 9 min old)

evidence.dominant_driver: BoE held at 3.75% as expected, but retained a 6-3 hawkish split, lifted its early-2027 inflation peak above 4%, and traders priced 38bp of hikes by year-end.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Pre-release markets put >80% odds on a hold; November hike was already heavily priced.

absorption.reason: Headline hold and vote matched expectations; new inflation projection is hawkish but November tightening was already heavily priced.

observations.oil: Brent/WTI lower, supportive for UK inflation/equities
observations.UK_rates: hawkish BoE details and higher inflation path

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast only. M2 ACTIONABLE learning for low-confidence MIXED 4h supports keeping neutral; no directional confidence boost.

regimes.UK_rates: BoE hold 3.75%; 6-3 with three hikes; traders price 38bp hikes by year-end

immediate.rationale: Hold and 6-3 vote were largely expected; the hawkish inflation forecast competes with supportive lower oil and slower gilt sales.

next_session.rationale: BoE hawkishness and easing energy prices remain offsetting forces.

15m.rationale: Hold and 6-3 vote were largely expected; the hawkish inflation forecast competes with supportive lower oil and slower gilt sales.

1h.rationale: Market had already priced a November hike heavily; residual UK100 direction is not clean.

4h.rationale: Lower oil supports UK equities while higher-rate expectations weigh on valuations.

next_session.rationale: BoE hawkishness and easing energy prices remain offsetting forces.

predictions.mechanism: Hawkish inflation/rate-path details weigh on valuations, but the expected hold, already-priced hike path, falling oil and slower active gilt sales offset the shock.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp post-release rise in UK gilt yields with FTSE breaking lower would turn the residual view bearish; a clear yield drop with falling oil would favor upside.
predictions.counter_case: If traders materially increase November/December hike pricing and gilt yields jump, UK100 can sell off despite the expected hold.
